error_localization.scope:
Localize fixed-stock capture error, without changing laws or adding samples.

Same68 frozen contexts/1256 actors. Two diagnostic ORACLES: supply actual target
relation but keep finite path law; supply actual path event but keep finite target
marginal. Neither is a rule-only estimator/material utility/legal mobility. No
fitting, thresholds, new games, profile/default or extension of earlier tests.
The decision is whether a next diagnostic should address endpoint population or
joint path structure; oracle error alone cannot identify a causal repair.
error_localization.decision: Actual-target oracle reduces capture MAE on all4 routes; actual-path oracle only slightly improves2 and worsens2. Endpoint population matters here; oracle inputs prohibit promoting this into a rule-only table or claiming a causal repair. No new law/default/sample extension.

type_localization.decision: Mixed signed type biases do not justify type constants. Largest error is five path-free enemy endpoints: target spatial population mismatch, not path correlation counting bug. Both stateful oracles remain diagnostic.

initial_template.scope:
Frozen initial-layout reference versus uniform-stock count diagnostic.
Decision: does retaining declared initial spatial structure offer useful raw
capture prediction, or is its utility lost after actual actions? Reuse same
68contexts/1256actors; no new sample, law sweep, parameter fitting or material
price claim. Chosen reference is the unmodified initial board from each RuleSet;
for every actual source/type, exclude that source from initial occupied cells,
place a hypothetical actor, and count enemy endpoints with actual event paths
on that fixed template. This substitution is an opportunity task, not a legal
position or conserved-stock distribution. Targets/types belong to the actual
actor; no actual enemy layout is read by the predictor. Descriptive comparison
on exposed routes grouped by initial vs successor and source initially own vs
other; exact counts/rule identities kept, no holdout restoration/default change.
Incremental cost <=60sec plus records; one writer, no search, seeds or worker.
initial_template.decision: Aggregate/earlier successor advantage is misleading alone.619/1256 unchanged-fact observations exact by construction; changed-fact MAE worsens2/4rules and changed-nonzero worsens2/4. Keep spatial task dependence explicit; do not promote reference into material prices or claim independent validation.
